statuses.qualified: A named artifact revision passed the documented real-runtime qualification scope. This does not imply deployment-account, cost, or every-platform qualification.
statuses.experimentally-working: A runtime smoke worked but the exact-artifact qualification record is incomplete.
statuses.unsupported: A verified blocker exists and no qualified consumer loading path ships.
statuses.not-evaluated: No runtime-specific exact-artifact result is available.

runtimes.name: Cloudflare Workers
runtimes.scope: Local workerd, full/common profiles, PII off/on; installed package receipts are required by new full qualification runs.
runtimes.limits: Local engine evidence, no Cloudflare account deployment or measured isolate memory. Fresh receipts live in each artifact inventory.

runtimes.name: Vercel Edge
runtimes.scope: Reference engine requires an import-free consumer build transform.
runtimes.limits: Production consumer build output remains unqualified; no edge-light loader.

runtimes.name: Deno Deploy / Bun / Fastly
runtimes.scope: Candidate workstreams outside the initial target.
runtimes.limits: No support claim or runtime-specific artifact evidence.
